newsitem.title: UK: One Brent cargo kept, Dated slips again - trade.
newsitem.headline: One Brent cargo kept, Dated slips again - trade.

text.p: The only Brent cargo nominated loading dates of June 18-20 on Tuesday was kept from the paper chains ahead of the five o'clock deadline, traders said.
They said the cargo was kept by Glencore.
A second cargo originally due to load in the same period was deferred to June 23-25, they said.
Meanwhile Dated Brent continued to lose ground as a June 10-12 cargo traded at July Brent -44 cents, seven cents weaker than two deals on Monday.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
A trading company is clocked when it is left with a paper cargo which has turned physical after that deadline and therefore cannot be passed on as part of pre-sold paper cargo deals.
